description: This file defines an interface IAsyncObserver<T> within the Orleans.Streams namespace, providing asynchronous methods for observing stream items, completion, and error events, specifically for use in the Orleans distributed streaming framework.

classes.name: IAsyncObserver<T>
classes.description: An interface that generalizes the standard .NET IObserver to support asynchronous production of items for Orleans streams.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous passing of the next item in the stream, returning a task that completes when the item has been accepted by the consumer.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles the notification that the stream has been completed, returning a task that completes when the completion has been processed.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles the notification that an error has occurred in the stream, accepting an exception and returning a task that completes when the error has been processed.
